claim_boundary: Retrospective source-only tuning and confirmation-cohort diagnosis on the released official 22-case PhysTwin cohort. The cohort and its frozen three-case development / nineteen-case confirmation split have already informed BayesianPhysTwin development. Results may diagnose evidence tempering, a model-average-specific fallback guard, and case-blocked covariance inflation, but must not be promoted as fresh independent validation, calibrated deployment uncertainty, or a new state-of-the-art claim.

group_conformal.across_case_rule: maximum development-case quantile within each horizon
group_conformal.calibration_support: future events on tracks updated before the prediction interval
group_conformal.covariance_action: multiply tempered covariance by max(1, group_quantile / chi_square_reference)

regret_guard.direction: accept tempered model average when score is less than or equal to the selected threshold
regret_guard.objective: minimum equal-development-case mean of the arithmetic mean of Chamfer and track ratios to fallback
regret_guard.score: within-case 90th percentile endpoint disagreement norm between tempered model average and last-supported residual over updated tracks

temperature_selection.hierarchical_component_weights: not fitted because three development groups do not support a stable 15-component prior
temperature_selection.objective: equal-development-case mean updated-only Gaussian negative log likelihood over future residual events
tie_break: lower equal-case combined point loss relative to last-supported residual
